data.name: AirMyne
data.description: AirMyne is a Berkeley, California-based Direct Air Capture startup founded in 2022 via Y Combinator by Sudip Mukhopadhyay and Mark Cyffka. The company uses a liquid solvent system with low-temperature thermal regeneration, allowing integration with waste heat and geothermal energy, and has raised over $11M in seed funding plus a strategic investment from ENEOS Holdings in 2026.
